text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Autsch... I let my guard down.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"It was a lack of attention on my part...
If only I had warmed up more thoroughly..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: At this rate, the schedule for entering the next race will be...
choice_data_list: Let's not rush—let's heal up slowly.
If you push yourself, you can still make it in time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, if I just sit still and rest,
my body will only grow sluggish.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If it's only for a little bit,
we could continue the training...
choice_data_list: Resting is part of the training, too.
Resting is part of the training, too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose so...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: You're completely right, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: To recover quickly, I should rest for now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash looked dejected
as she focused on resting.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
I shouldn't give up so easily, right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Let's change our remaining schedule
to light strength training and stretches.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: In that case, we can continue practicing.
choice_data_list: Don't you go pushing yourself too hard.
Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'll be fine, so please watch me—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! Ow...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Forcing myself to move only worsened the injury.
It looks like it will take some time to recover.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Now that it's come to this, we should consider a practice
plan that takes the condition of the injury into account."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"First, reassess diet and sleep.
Then, manageable strength training..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You can also forge mental strength
through mental training, after all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Shall we put together
a new schedule right away?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash kept up with a reasonable training regimen and made a splendid comeback!
